collection.description: A fisher blames an otter for the dwindling abalone, and a jeweler wants the shells.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A fisher blames an otter for the decline of abalone near a rocky shore. A jeweler wants the shells too.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: Surveys show the population is low, but not why.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The new shore has fewer shells and different wildlife.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: The community tries seasonal rules, then must check whether they help.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: The animal remains and shell harvest is reduced; some fishers grumble.
